relationships.subject: um-PEA and LAC
relationships.evidence_quote: Immunohistochemical analysis of TNF-α showed a significant increased expression in paw tissue from CAR injected rats (Figure 5B,F), whereas um-PEA and LAC (5 mg/kg) reduced such positive staining (Figure 5E,F).

relationships.subject: um-PEA and LAC
relationships.evidence_quote: Um-PEA and LAC (5 mg/kg) administration significantly reduced the COX-2 expression (Figure 7E,F)

relationships.subject: um-PEA and LAC
relationships.evidence_quote: ICAM-1 staining was significantly reduced in paw tissue collected from CAR-treated rats and those subjected to treatment with um-PEA and LAC (5 mg/kg)

relationships.subject: um-PEA and LAC
relationships.evidence_quote: Oral administration of um-PEA and LAC (1:1) (5 mg/kg) caused a clear inhibition of the development of CAR-induced thermal hyperalgesia already after 3 h from CAR injection

key_findings: Co-formulated um-PEA and LAC (5 mg/kg) reduced carrageenan paw edema, hyperalgesia, MPO, mast cells, ICAM-1, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, COX-2 and iNOS
Separate consecutive administration of the compounds at low doses was ineffective
